entities.name: PMID:27489205
observations: 2017 International Journal of Paediatric Dentistry updated systematic review and meta-analysis of ART for occlusoproximal cavities in primary teeth.
Searches covered PubMed/MEDLINE through February 2016, Web of Science, and EMBASE; four articles were included in qualitative and quantitative analyses.

entities.name: Atraumatic restorative treatment
observations: For primary molar occlusoproximal cavities, ART is described as hand excavation followed by high-viscosity glass-ionomer cement.
The updated review found no statistically significant survival difference versus conventional restorative treatment: OR 0.887, 95% CI 0.574–1.371.

entities.name: ART survival equivalence
observations: In four included articles, ART restoration survival was not statistically different from conventional treatment; pooled OR 0.887 with 95% CI 0.574–1.371.
The review concluded ART can be considered an option for occlusoproximal cavities in primary molars.
